newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin to meet Russia premier ahead of Kiev visit.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin to meet Russia premier ahead of Kiev visit.

text.p: Russian President Boris Yeltsin, due to visit Ukraine on Friday, will meet Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin on Thursday, the Kremlin press service said.

It did not give details but Interfax news agency said they would discuss agreements, including a deal over the shareout of the former Soviet Black Sea fleet, which Chernomyrdin reached in Kiev on Wednesday in talks with Ukraine's President Leonid Kuchma and Prime Minister Pavlo Lazarenko.
The documents, which resolved a long and heated dispute between the two Slav ex-Soviet neighbours, will allow Yeltsin and Kuchma to sign a much-delayed friendship treaty.
Under the deal Ukraine leases its naval base at Sevastopol to Russia for 20 years.
Chernomyrdin talks also covered Kiev's repayments of its debt to Russia for energy supplies and compensation to Ukraine for nuclear missiles taken to Russia after the break-up of the Soviet Union.

The Kremlin also said Yeltsin would deliver a radio address, due to be broadcast on Friday (eds: 0500 GMT) on the signing of the "Founding Act on Mutual Cooperation" which defines relations between Russia and NATO in the post Cold War world.
Yeltsin signed the deal with 16 NATO leaders on Tuesday.
